desc: You didn't come this far to miss. HEVI-Shot goes ultra-dense with HEVI-18 TSS Turkey. The 18 g/cc density pellets allow for smaller shot and higher pellet counts for the ultimate in long-range lethality. We achieve incredibly tight patterns thanks to our unique, friction-free, sealed-in-the-shell spherical buffer. With HEVI-18 being 48% more dense than lead, you can drop down 3 shot sizes for the same down range lethality! Heavy payloads of 7 & 9 shot are available.
